title: 非限制性定语从句与介词 + 关系代词
summary: 用逗号隔开的"补充说明"从句,以及介词提前后的 which/whom 用法,让书面表达更地道。

title: 同位语从句与名词性从句进阶
summary: 分清 that 同位语从句与 that 定语从句,掌握 whether/if、疑问词引导的名词性从句的细节。

title: 虚拟语气:与现在事实相反

title: 虚拟语气:与过去事实相反
summary: 谈"当时没发生"的假设:从句 had + 过去分词,主句 would have + 过去分词。

title: 混合条件句与错综时间

title: wish、would rather、if only 与 it's time

title: 完全倒装

title: 部分倒装:否定词与 only 前置

title: as 引导的倒装与比较结构
summary: as/though 让步从句的倒装,以及 the more... the more、no more... than 等比较句式。

title: 强调句型:It is ... that ...
summary: It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其余部分:强调主语、宾语、状语,让重点凸出来。

title: 省略:让句子更简洁

title: 独立主格结构
summary: 名词 + 分词/形容词/介词短语构成的独立结构,作状语补充背景,让描写更有层次。

title: 衔接词与语篇连贯:第三年综合演练
summary: 用 however、therefore、in contrast 等衔接词把长难句、虚拟、倒装、强调串成连贯语篇,并做全年综合自测。

title: 分词完成式与被动式:having done / being done

title: 主谓一致进阶:就近与就远原则

title: 替代与省略:one / that / do so

title: 插入语与同位语:长难句打断点
summary: 双逗号/双破折号间的插入语可先跳过;同位语对名词进一步说明,帮助拆解长难句。

title: 比较结构进阶:the more...the more 与倍数表达
summary: 成比例增长用"the + 比较级,the + 比较级";倍数用"倍数 + as...as / 比较级 than / the size of"。

title: 情态动词完成式:must / should / could have done
summary: 对过去的推测与评价:must have done(肯定发生过)、should have done(本应)、needn't have done(本不必)。

title: 含蓄条件句:without / but for / otherwise
summary: 不用 if 也能暗示条件:介词短语 without/but for 与副词 otherwise 暗含虚拟条件,时态按虚拟规则选。

title: Subjunctive mood after wish · 要点精讲

title: Formal subject it · 要点精讲
summary: it acts as formal subject, replacing the real subject (infinitive or clause) placed later.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。

title: Formal object it · 要点精讲

title: Inversion with fronted negative words · 综合测试
summary: Negative or semi-negative adverbs at the start of a sentence require partial inversion.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Never/Hardly/Not only + auxiliary + subject + base form。

title: only + adverbial inversion · 综合测试
summary: When only + adverbial (time/condition) is fronted, partial inversion is used; only modifying the subject does not invert.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Only + adverbial at the start of a sentence: auxiliary + subject + base form。

title: so / neither partial inversion · 综合测试
summary: so/neither indicates 'the same is true (not)' and takes partial inversion, avoiding repetition.本课为综合测试练习,核心:so + auxiliary + subject = the same is true; neither/nor + auxiliary + subject = the same negative is true。

title: Cleft sentences It is...that · 综合测试
summary: Cleft sentences emphasize the subject, object or adverbial: It is...that/who..., the tense stays unchanged.本课为综合测试练习,核心:It is + emphasized part + that + the rest of the sentence。

title: Formal subject it · 综合测试
summary: it acts as formal subject, replacing the real subject (infinitive or clause) placed later.本课为综合测试练习,核心:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。

title: Formal object it · 综合测试
summary: it acts as formal object, replacing the infinitive or clause object placed after the complement.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Subject + verb + it + complement + real object (to do/that clause)。

title: with compound structures · 综合测试
summary: The with compound structure expresses accompanying state; the complement is determined by the relation to the noun.本课为综合测试练习,核心:with + noun + complement (adjective/adverb/V-ing/past participle) as an adverbial or modifier。

title: Absolute constructions · 综合测试
summary: The absolute construction = noun + adjective/adverb/past participle/infinitive, as an adverbial expressing time, reason or accompanying state.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Noun + complement independent structure, separated from the main clause by a comma。

title: Non-restrictive relative clauses · 综合测试
summary: Non-restrictive relative clauses add supplementary explanation; a comma is essential, that is forbidden.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Separated from the antecedent by a comma; that cannot be used; who/which are used。

title: Preposition + which / whom · 综合测试
summary: Preposition + which/whom structure in formal written style; the preposition comes from the collocation with the verb.本课为综合测试练习,核心:The preposition can be placed before which/whom: the house in which I live。

title: whose relative clauses · 综合测试
summary: whose introduces a relative clause expressing belonging to the antecedent, followed by a noun.本课为综合测试练习,核心:whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。

title: Noun clauses with what · 综合测试
summary: What guides a noun clause and itself serves as a subject or object inside the clause, meaning 'what/who'.本课为综合测试练习,核心:what = the thing(s) that, serving as subject/object inside the clause。

title: Subject clauses with whether · 综合测试
summary: Whether guides a subject clause at the start of a sentence; if is not used; the clause uses statement word order.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Whether guides a subject clause and cannot be replaced by if。

title: Subject clauses with that · 综合测试
summary: A that-clause as subject is usually replaced by the formal subject it: It is clear that...本课为综合测试练习,核心:That guides a subject clause but cannot be omitted; it is often placed later with the formal subject it。

title: Present participles as adverbials · 综合测试
summary: A present participle phrase as adverbial; its logical subject must agree with the sentence's subject.本课为综合测试练习,核心:V-ing as adverbial expresses time, reason or accompanying state; the logical subject is the sentence's subject。

title: Past participles as adverbials · 综合测试
summary: A past participle phrase as adverbial, the logical subject passively receives the action.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Past participle as adverbial expresses passivity or completion。

title: Perfect infinitives · 综合测试
summary: The perfect infinitive expresses an action that happened before the predicate verb.本课为综合测试练习,核心:to have done expresses an action completed before the predicate verb。

title: as concession inversion · 综合测试
summary: The as-concession inversion: Young as he is, he knows a lot.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Adjective/adverb/noun + as + subject + verb = although。

title: while / whereas contrast · 综合测试
summary: while used at the start of a sentence means 'whereas', connecting two contrasting clauses.本课为综合测试练习,核心:while connects two clauses expressing contrast。

title: Compound sentences and semicolons · 综合测试
summary: Semicolons join parallel clauses; the linking adverbs however/therefore need a semicolon before them.本课为综合测试练习,核心:Semicolons join two closely related clauses; a comma cannot join two sentences。

title: Appositives · 综合测试
summary: An appositive further explains the preceding noun and can be a word, phrase or clause.本课为综合测试练习,核心:A noun placed after another noun explains it; often separated by commas。
